8954894123228.title: Arcadia
8954894123228.description:
TOP NOTES : Lotus, Freesia, Calone, Rose

MIDDLE NOTES : Lily, Osmanthus

BASE NOTES : Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Virginia Cedar, Sandalwood

Eau de Parfum (EDP) offers a long-lasting, rich fragrance with 15–20% perfume oil concentration, perfect for day or night wear

1. Understand the Fragrance
This perfume has a fresh, floral, and slightly woody fragrance—light, sweet, and long-lasting.
2. Key Selling Points
• First Smell (Fresh & Light): Lotus, freesia, and a hint of rose—like a fresh bouquet.
• After 1 hour while (Soft & Sweet): Lily adds a gentle, fruity-floral touch.
• After 2 hours (Warm & Lasting): Musk, cedar, and sandalwood give a cozy, woody finish that stays for hours.

Spray the perfume on a tester card or customer’s wrist & explain: “It starts with a fresh floral touch, then becomes soft and sweet, and finally, leaves a warm, cozy and woody finish that lasts all day.”

Highlight Benefits:
• Perfect for everyday use.
• Balanced scent, not too strong, not too light – just perfect.


Quantity: 100ml – A generous size, perfect for everyday wear and long-lasting fragrance enjoyment.

Starlet Perfume Exchange Policy

Only sealed, unopened perfumes can be exchanged.

Exchange is only allowed with other perfumes.

Damaged or broken bottles won't be accepted.

Price differences must be paid by the customer.

Sale/discounted items are non-returnable.

In-store testers are available.

8962321088732.title: Arctic Rush
8962321088732.description:
TOP NOTES : Bergamot, Mandarin Orange

MIDDLE NOTES : Green Tea, Black Currant

BASE NOTES : Musk, Sandalwood, Petitgrain, Galbanum

Eau de Parfum (EDP) offers a long-lasting, rich fragrance with 15–20% perfume oil concentration, perfect for day or night wear

1. Understand the Fragrance
This is a fresh, citrusy, and slightly woody fragrance, perfect for those who love a light and refreshing scent.
2. Key Selling Points
• First Spray (First Impression): Bergamot, Mandarin Orange – These give a fresh and citrusy start, making the fragrance feel bright, energetic, and refreshing.
• After 1 Hour (Heart of the Perfume): Green Tea, Black Currant – These add a soft, slightly sweet, and herbal touch, balancing the freshness.
• After 2 Hours (Lasting Impression): Musk, Sandalwood, Petitgrain, Galbanum – These create a smooth, woody, and slightly musky finish.

Spray the perfume on a tester card or the customer’s wrist or tester & Explain: “It starts with a burst of fresh citrus, then softens into a sweet and herbal note, and finally settles into a warm, woody, and musky scent that lasts all day.”

Highlight Benefits:
• A fresh, elegant, and energetic scent

TOP NOTES : Jasmine

MIDDLE NOTES : Tuberose

BASE NOTES : Rangoon Creeper

Eau de Parfum (EDP) offers a long-lasting, rich fragrance with 15–20% perfume oil concentration, perfect for day or night wear

1. Understand the Fragrance
A gorgeous and elegant floral scent, like a bouquet of the most beautiful flowers.
2. Key Selling Points
• First Spray (First Impression): Jasmine – A sweet, fresh, and luxurious floral scent that feels elegant.
• After 1 Hour (Heart of the Perfume): Tuberose – Adds a rich, creamy, and slightly sweet floral touch.
• After 2 Hours (Lasting Impression): Warm, slightly fruity aroma. A rare and exotic floral note that gives the perfume a warm and slightly fruity finish, making it unique.

Spray the perfume on a tester card or the customer’s tester & explain: “It opens with a fresh and delicate jasmine scent, then becomes rich and creamy with tuberose, and finally settles into a warm, slightly sweet floral touch.”

Quantity: 100ml – A generous size, perfect for everyday wear and long-lasting fragrance enjoyment.


Highlight Benefits:
• A beautiful, floral, and elegant scent.
• Perfect for both everyday wear.
• Unique aroma, with rare floral ingredients.

Starlet Perfume Exchange Policy

Only sealed, unopened perfumes can be exchanged.

Exchange is only allowed with other perfumes.

Damaged or broken bottles won't be accepted.

Price differences must be paid by the customer.

Sale/discounted items are non-returnable.

Strong yet refined, Junoon represents passion at its highest intensity — a scent for those who live with fearless confidence and unstoppable ambition.

PERFUME INSPIRATION

Koh-e-Sim is inspired by the serene beauty of silver mountains and the clarity of fresh alpine air. Bright citrus, delicate tea notes, and soft musk come together to create a fragrance that feels clean, refreshing, and timeless.

Description

Fragrance Family: FRESH & MOUNTAINOUS

A fragrance inspired by the purity of snow-covered peaks and the freshness of mountain air.

As the fragrance develops, smooth tea accords and soft florals create a clean and elegant heart, bringing balance and calmness. The scent gently settles into a refined base of musk and soft woods, leaving a cool, sophisticated trail.

Pure, refreshing, and effortlessly elegant, Koh-e-Sim reflects the beauty of nature and the quiet strength of the mountains.

Only sealed, unopened perfumes can be exchanged.

9285627052252.title: OUD-AL-RAFEY
9285627052252.description:
Top Notes: Saffron, Pink Pepper, Raspberry

Heart Notes: Turkish Rose, Oud Wood, Jasmine

Base Notes: Praline, Amber, Vanilla, Sandalwood, Musk

 

Key Ingredients:

Oud Wood, Rose, Praline, Amber, Vanilla, Musk

Perfume Inspiration

Oud Al Rafay is a celebration of oud in its most seductive form. Rich, bold, and irresistibly smooth, this creation blends depth with sweetness to awaken the senses. A fragrance crafted for those who embrace power, elegance, and the beauty of contrast.

Eau de Parfum (EDP) offers a long-lasting, rich fragrance with 15–20% perfume oil concentration, perfect for day or night wear

Description

Fragrance Family: DARK & MYSTERIOUS

A bold encounter where precious oud meets sensual sweetness.

Deep, captivating, and powerful, Oud Al Rafay balances darkness with warmth. The richness of intense oud wood unfolds slowly, wrapped in velvety sweetness and soft floral whispers. It is both refined and daring a scent that lingers between elegance and temptation.

Smoky, warm, and hypnotic, the fragrance carries a luxurious aura, where dark oud merges with subtle sweetness and delicate florals, creating a signature that is unforgettable.

Like a quiet summer night under endless stars, Oud Al Rafay evokes mystery, confidence, and timeless sophistication.


Quantity: 100ml – A generous size, perfect for everyday wear and long-lasting fragrance enjoyment.

Starlet Perfume Exchange Policy

Only sealed, unopened perfumes can be exchanged.

Exchange is only allowed with other perfumes.

Damaged or broken bottles won't be accepted.

Price differences must be paid by the customer.

Sale/discounted items are non-returnable.

In-store testers are available.

9285630656732.description:
Top Notes: Cardamom, Pink Pepper

Heart Notes: Leather Accord, Jasmine Sambac Base Notes: Amber, Patchouli, Moss, Cedarwood

Key Ingredients:

Leather, Amber, Patchouli, Cedarwood

PERFUME INSPIRATION

The Sultan is inspired by the raw beauty of leather and the spirit of fearless leadership. Rich leather blended with warm spices and smoky woods creates a fragrance that embodies power, confidence, and timeless elegance.

Description

Fragrance Family: LEATHER & SMOKY

A fragrance that captures power, confidence, and royal strength.

The Sultan is bold and commanding, opening with a fresh burst of spicy warmth that immediately captures attention. As the scent unfolds, rich leather emerges — deep, smooth, and luxurious creating an aura of timeless masculinity.

Warm amber and smoky woods surround the leather heart, adding depth and sensuality. The result is a fragrance that feels powerful yet refined, like the presence of a true ruler.

Dark, elegant, and unforgettable, The Sultan leaves behind a trail of strength, mystery, and authority.

 

Starlet Perfume Exchange Policy

Only sealed, unopened perfumes can be exchanged.

Exchange is only allowed with other perfumes.

Damaged or broken bottles won't be accepted.
